# Tool Reference

| Tool | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| [ArXivTool](arxiv.md) | Search arXiv papers, fetch metadata by ID, and download PDFs. |
| [PubMedTool](pubmed.md) | Search PubMed, fetch article metadata, and retrieve abstracts. |
| [SemanticScholarTool](semantic_scholar.md) | Search Semantic Scholar papers, citations, and references. |
| [RSSFeedTool](rss.md) | Fetch, browse, and search any RSS/Atom feed by URL. |
| [NewsTool](news.md) | Aggregate top headlines and search news across reputable RSS sources (+ optional NewsAPI). |
| [YouTubeTranscriptTool](youtube.md) | Fetch YouTube video captions/transcripts without a Google API key. |
| [YouTubeMetadataTool](youtube.md) | Fetch YouTube video or channel metadata using yt-dlp (no auth required). |
| [RedditTool](reddit.md) | Fetch posts and comments from Reddit via public JSON endpoints (no auth). |
| [HackerNewsTool](hackernews.md) | Fetch Hacker News stories, items, and user profiles via the Firebase API. |
| [TranslateTool](translate.md) | Translate text between languages (LibreTranslate primary; argostranslate offline fallback). |
| [LanguageDetectTool](language_detect.md) | Detect the language of text, fully offline (langdetect, 55+ languages). |
| [QRGenerateTool](qr.md) | Generate QR codes locally from any text or URL (no network required). |
| [QRReadTool](qr.md) | Decode QR codes and barcodes from image files or base64 PNG (local, needs libzbar). |
| [OpenAI native tools](openai_native.md) | Use OpenAI-hosted web search, code interpreter, and file search. |
| [Gemini native tools](gemini_native.md) | Use Gemini-hosted Google Search, URL context, and code execution. |
| [Anthropic native tools](anthropic_native.md) | Use Anthropic-hosted computer-use tools. |
| [Agent interop protocols](protocols.md) | Expose effGen tools over MCP, consume external MCP/A2A/ACP servers. |
